messages.subject: Stan crashes R
parts:
Hi, Stan crashed R again for me. No big deal, this happens all the time. Unfortunately, as always, I can’t reproduce the crash. I think it happens because of a sequence or problems, not just with the fitting of a single model. In any case, I just wanted to let you know that I’m working on isolating the problem even if with no success yet.
